props.title: How the six Skills work together
props.lead: The host-specific and universal plugins provide the same six Skills. The agent selects a workflow for the task; you choose whether to save the work and in which project.

content.text: Skills are work instructions written to the Agent and distributed with the plug-in; the actual storage, component compilation and rendering are completed by the ShowAI runtime. All documentation operations for the Agent occur through the MCP, and the CLI is only used for startup, diagnostics, and scripting.

values.task: Connect, find content, confirm project ownership and recover items.
values.host: Codex and Antigravity include their own workbench and reference instructions. The universal plugin can guide manual MCP setup.

values.task: Preview 1–5 components in chat. For a known component ID, read its guide directly.
values.host: Selection and data formats are shared. The host determines how a visual is displayed.

values.task: Plan, design, create, review, save and revise a work.
values.host: The authoring workflow is shared. After saving, the host delivers a page card, a preview or a link.

values.task: Build, adapt and verify reusable components.
Create a template or extract one from an existing work.
Collaborate during editing, work with selections and positions, and pair devices.

content.text: “Let me try this chart” uses show-visual. With a known connection, choose a component, read its guide and display it. A known ID skips catalog discovery. Asking to keep the chart prompts the agent to confirm a project and save the same data.
Creating and revising a saved page

“Make this an editable report” uses show-document. Reader intent, evidence, structure, design, authoring, review and delivery are stages within this workflow. Revisions start by reading the original and saving against its current hash and revision.
How templates and components work together
And fill in the agreement, component reuse

, the specific facts this time are stored in Page. Agent first selects an expression suitable for understanding the task, and then checks the current directory; it prioritizes adjusting and combining existing components, and only develops new components if there are gaps.
After confirming the saved project and page identity, deliver through the host. Codex and Antigravity return original-page cards by default; other hosts can return a reader preview or page link.

Source data verification, static screenshots, actual operations and reader readings provide different evidence, and the Agent will explain what was done respectively. The scope that has not been actually checked must be clearly told to you; without real people trying to read it, it does not claim to have proven the understanding effect.
